target_profile.system_boundary: Captured Go EPaxos package plus its in-repository replica, RPC, master, state and server-entry support; other protocol implementations are outside this initial map.
protocol_contexts: Static participant set; default volatile server deployment
ownership: Protocol run goroutine owns handlers; executor is separate
Master owns registration and leader preference; per-instance owners form commands
selection_injection: Thrifty=true in EPaxos constructor; Durable=false, transconf=false in server entry
unknowns: Restart reconstruction and client retry duties not established

activities.purpose: Qualified support for formation and advancement
activities.realization_summary: Local owner batches commands, forms dependency attributes, counts qualified phase replies, and propagates full decisions; Accept update/status discrepancy remains open.

Per-instance bal promises reject older requests; lastTriedBallot qualifies replies. Recovery gathers prior support and chooses a path via VBallot/status. Master IsLeader is retry preference, not exclusive proposal authority.
Executor detects incomplete known prefixes and queues per-instance recovery; recovery selection and transport are implementation-owned.
Fixed peer addresses and Alive/preferred order control recipients; quorum sizes derive from N/F. No dynamic membership path established.
Committed dependency graph is traversed as SCCs; commands are applied and marked EXECUTED.
Stored bal/vbal/status/attributes are exposed through PrepareReply transport. Optional disk methods exist but default deployment disables Durable and no reconstruction was established.
PROPOSE enters a delayed channel; owner retains client metadata; default replies follow execution. Retry duties remain unread.

facts.meaning: Stored command attributes and status associated with the local instance, with bal used for promise checks and vbal reported as value provenance; status does not necessarily advance on an Accept handler update.
facts.validity_context: One local replica and current instance state; revised by protocol and recovery handlers.
facts.durability: In memory in the configured Durable=false server path; optional persistence is not assumed to reconstruct it.
facts.recovery: Prepare reports stored fields; recovery selection may reuse or replace them.

facts.meaning: The producer-side PrepareReply reports the local promise, value ballot, status and attributes for a requested instance. This assertion is about the constructed reply, not guaranteed end-to-end transport preservation.
facts.validity_context: Reply construction in handlePrepare, or self report construction in startRecoveryForInstance; fields describe that producer point.
facts.recovery: handlePrepareReply consumes VBallot to select retained support after matching request Ballot.
unknowns: Whether serialization preserves the value provenance needed by the consumer.

facts.meaning: A local instance is marked COMMITTED or later EXECUTED with command attributes, permitting dependency-ordered consumption; this records the implementation state rather than proving cluster agreement.
facts.validity_context: Current local instance after formation, commit delivery or recovery selection.
facts.recovery: Committed reports may be selected during recovery; full Commit distributes commands.

core_overview.rationale: Representative formation, transfer of per-instance authority, prior support, transport and application paths have been traced. Usability describes navigation, not correctness or exhaustive coverage.

formation.explanation: A proposal is batched into its receiving replica row and starts phase 1 with owner-ID ballot. Conflict indices establish Seq/Deps. Thrifty PreAccept reaches selected alive peers, whose reports are qualified by lastTriedBallot and phase status. The owner merges attributes and either fast commits under threshold/equality/initial-ballot conditions (with a small-cluster exception) or broadcasts Accept and commits after a majority count. Full Commit carries commands and attributes; receivers reject stale ballots and already established decisions. Default Dreply=true delays client response until dependency/SCC execution. Sender and receiver codecs, not just handler structs, are part of this relationship.

context.explanation: Authority is per row/instance. inst.bal guards incoming work; leader bookkeeping lastTriedBallot guards phase replies. Executor-driven recovery replaces local attempt bookkeeping while retaining proposals and stored value; generated ballots depend on ID/N and optionally maxRecvBallot under master-granted IsLeader. Prepare raises the promise and reports prior vbal/status/attributes. A slow quorum including the self report selects support using VBallot, then preserves a reported committed state, accepts retained support, or restarts phase 1. Prior committed instances with commands bypass recovery. No global revocation mechanism was found; stale work is handled by these local promise/status/phase checks, whose actual strength remains investigable.

connection.explanation: Recovery authority does not independently determine a new value: its consumer uses reported support provenance/status and attributes to decide which formation path is eligible. bal may rise while vbal and prior attributes remain in handlePrepare, separating promise from support. The local recovery entry instead updates both ballots before self reporting; remote replies cross a codec that omits VBallot. These discrepancies are unresolved premises of support preservation, not assumed agreement failures. Old phase replies face attempt/phase guards; established commit messages have status/ballot guards. Pending client proposals are retained across recovery and sometimes requeued after NOOP; consumption still requires complete committed dependencies.

open_details: PrepareReply transport provenance preservation is the first discriminator.
Accept status, recovery self provenance, ballot reuse and tie selection require separate legal-history investigation.
Optional durability/restart scope, client retries, SCAN ranges and execution-order ties remain open.
